title: Mopeka Propane Tank Weekly Refill Cycle Trend
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mopeka:tank refill_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(refill_days) as avg_duration, max(refill_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst refill cycle for Mopeka propane tank events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture refill_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average refill cycle with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether Mopeka propane tank tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
